about.title: A journey guided by energy and purpose
about.bio: I'm Abir Diab, and I truly believe you are here for a reason. My journey started in 2008, fueled by a deep passion for understanding energy, healing, and the unseen magic of the universe. Along the way, I mastered Reiki, Pranic Healing, Hypnosis, Dowsing, and, most powerfully, Pendulum Healing. Beyond techniques, my purpose has always been the same — to help others remember their power, heal from within, and create a life of harmony and abundance. Through 1:1 coaching, guided meditations, and deep energy work, I've helped so many beautiful souls release old wounds and step into their true essence.
about.quote: You are worthy of healing. You are worthy of love. And you are capable of incredible transformation.

sessions.title: 1:1 Sessions
sessions.body1:
Have you ever felt like you're carrying a weight no one else can see? Sometimes life shakes us so deeply that returning to "normal" feels impossible.

But you don't have to go through this alone. No two sessions are the same, because no two journeys are the same.
checklist: Find clarity after trauma or loss
sessions.body2: Support doesn’t end when the session does — you’ll leave with grounding practices and an open line to reach out as you integrate what came up.

meditations.title: What if meditation could unlock miracles?
meditations.body: For three years, Miraculous Monday has brought a weekly guided meditation to those who needed it most. The science is simple: meditative states reduce stress and enhance brain function — and these recordings were created so that healing work could travel with you, wherever you are.

items.q: How do I book a session?
items.a: Use the Book button on this site to pick a date and time, then confirm your booking online.

items.q: Do I need prior experience with energy work?
items.a: No prior experience is needed — every session and course starts from wherever you are.

items.q: Are sessions online or in person?
items.a: Both. Most 1:1 sessions happen online over video call; in-person sessions can be arranged by request.

items.q: How long do I have access after purchasing a course?
items.a: Lifetime access to everything you purchase, streamed through the portal or downloadable, depending on the item.

items.q: Can I try something before I buy?
items.a: Yes — every course and meditation has a free preview: a sample lesson, chapter, or short audio clip.

items.q: What languages are sessions offered in?
items.a: Arabic and English, for sessions, courses and written material alike.
